# Generated evidence: morpho/vault-deposit

Written by `pnpm report morpho/vault-deposit --record` from `templates/morpho/vault-deposit/template.json`, `templates/morpho/vault-deposit/docs.json`, `registry/contracts.json`, `testdata/report/morpho-vault-deposit.json`, `testdata/abi`, `testdata/research/morpho-vault-deposit-windows.json`, `testdata/research/morpho-vault-deposit.json`. The listings and pages were read on 2026-11-10. `pnpm test` computes it again from these files and fails on any difference: every section is recomputed from the recorded answers except the vault evidence, which is stored as `pnpm vault-evidence` printed it. The recordings were made on the AI's computer; `pnpm report morpho/vault-deposit --compare` reads the listings, pages, ABI proofs and ERC-7730 attestations live, reads each vault again at the blocks its evidence names, fetches each recorded past transaction again by hash, and prints each fact that differs. It does not search for past transactions again, so it cannot show that a search found every one. Text from outside the program appears only as identifiers: a contract name Sourcify gives, printed only when it is a Solidity identifier, and the file paths, field paths and format names `pnpm erc7730` prints. The URLs come from the registry and `docs.json`, in RFC 3986 characters only. Text the AI wrote appears only where a row says it was written by the AI in the template. Do not edit this file.

## Official documentation

Each page comes from `docs.json`, whose contract must be the one the template calls the function on when the template binds it. The program compares the page's registrable domain, or GitHub organization, with the DefiLlama protocol of that contract, checks that a GitHub page is pinned to a commit on the default branch, and looks for the function's bare name as a whole word in the page as served, without scripts. A PASS there shows that the page names a function of that name, not that it documents this contract's function.

| `multicall((address,bytes,uint256,bool,bytes32)[])` | `bundler3` | <https://docs.morpho.org/developers/contracts/bundles/> | PASS | n/a | PASS |

## Vaults

For each vault, the stored output of `pnpm vault-evidence`, not recomputed by `pnpm test`; `pnpm report --compare` reads it again at the blocks it names.

### `steakhouse-prime-usdc`

